answer.generated: Two key design issues in distributed systems engineering are transparency and openness. Transparency concerns the extent to which a distributed system should appear to users as a single cohesive entity, potentially simplifying user interaction but complicating system management. Openness involves designing systems using standard protocols that support interoperability versus more specialized protocols that may offer greater flexibility but reduce compatibility with other systems.
